correctness.rationale: The restriction of the seventh-power sum to the linear hyperplane is not identically zero (use coordinates 1,1,−2,0,…). The projective Jacobian condition gives common nonzero sixth powers, hence precisely the zero-sum sixth-root tuples modulo free simultaneous scaling. In the chart x_N=1, the Hessian is 42 times the diagonal with entries x_i^5 plus the rank-one term with coefficient x_{N−1}^5. Its rank-one determinant multiplier is 1+x_{N−1}^5∑_{i≤N−2}x_i=−1/x_{N−1}. This proves nondegeneracy and, by the local Jacobian ideal, reducedness. Every intersection of distinct components would have dimension at least N−4≥1, contradicting isolated singularities; repeated factors also contradict isolated singularities. S_2 and R_1 give normality. The triangular-lattice constant term follows by using the primitive sixth root basis and inverting one Laurent variable; (S+2)^k has the order-three Franel constant term. Normalization makes the field of every point a subfield of Q(√−3); rational points are exactly balanced signs and the remaining Galois orbits have length two. Independent walk DP and the finite binomial sum agreed through N=12, with explicit walk enumeration through N=7 and independent sign checks through N=8. Counts for N=5,…,10 and the two small residue-field decompositions agree.
residual_risks: Finite computations corroborate the numerical instances only. No positive-characteristic or general diagonal-hyperplane classification was audited.

evidence: The even-semiprime entry proves the theorem for degree 2p+1, p any odd prime, with the same N≥5; it gives finite étaleness and arithmetic splitting, and even includes a permutation-orbit refinement. The prime-cyclotomic entry is about degree p+1, not the same specialization.
broader_coverage.reasoning: p=3 gives exactly degree seven and Q(ζ_3)=Q(√−3). Taking the reduced locus of the finite étale scheme does not change it. The Lam–Leung length theorem is weaker for this census; Fermat period theory is background.

evidence: The coefficient series H_k(z)=∑_{a≥0}z^(2a+k)/(a!(a+k)!) is I_k(2z). The p=3 geometric count in the semiprime record is N!/6 times the coefficient of H_0³+2∑_{k≥1}H_k³ (terms with 3k>N vanish); the series in parentheses is the A002898 exponential generating function.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The broader theorem plus the already tabulated identity implies all the frozen assertions, including the choice of Franel presentation. Neither the common date nor the use of a different coefficient formula makes this a distinct scientific claim.

originality.rationale: Two affirmative comparisons exhaust the frozen finding. A distinct co-dated Resultary theorem specializes at p=3 to the identical septic variety and covers the geometry, exact count, and even the full scheme-theoretic splitting. OEIS A002898 already states precisely the Franel transform of the triangular lattice closed-walk count as well as the exponential generating function underlying the general theorem's count at p=3. There is no distinct residual counting theorem. This is statement-level coverage, not a determination of priority between same-day records.
residual_risks: Neither catalogue date nor public search establishes priority. The originality failure rests on demonstrable separate stronger and equivalent coverage, not on an inaccessible source or a failed lookup.

value.rationale: The geometry and residue fields of these symmetric sections are meaningful invariants in themselves. As a standalone contribution, however, this record only recombines a covered specialization of the entire nodal scheme with an already explicit expression for the same walk sequence. Neither a new sharp invariant nor a new mathematical consequence beyond that coverage is exhibited. The elementary constant-term proof can still be useful exposition; it does not supply an audit-worthy new scientific remainder.
residual_risks: This does not devalue the broader theorem or rule out a different worthwhile follow-up. No genuine surviving repair of the frozen finding was established.
